title: Depth at a gate
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ input vertices, and let $i$ be a gate index with $i<|C|$. The depth assigned to vertex $n+i$ equals one plus the maximum of zero and the depths of the vertices read by gate $i$, where any depth lookup beyond the available depth list is taken to be zero.
hypotheses_covered: A directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ input vertices
